narrative: OMX30 enters Friday with powerful technical setup: +9.1% above 200-MA, MACD positive, ADX 60.1 showing strong trending structure. However, RSI 80.84 flashes mean reversion risk—market is overbought and sitting just 0.9% from 52-week highs. Global backdrop is mixed (European indices down, US tech up), but USD/SEK strength and gold's modest gain provide selective support to exporters and mining. The bulls control the technicals, but positioning is extended; watch for consolidation or 2-3% pullback from current euphoria. Key pivot at 3123 (yesterday's close); watch support at 3085 (lower Bollinger).
morningBrief: OMX30 opens into technical overbought conditions after strong run—RSI 80.84 and 0.9% from 52-week highs warrant caution despite positive MACD and ADX 60 trending. Exporters get USD/SEK bid (+0.68%): Volvo B, Atlas Copco A, Ericsson B should outperform on currency tailwind. Boliden worth watching as gold +0.63% offsets copper weakness. European weakness (DAX -0.23%, CAC -0.46%) and US 10Y yields stable (4.682%) limit downside, but be ready for profit-taking if we tag 3180 resistance. Sector rotation: Industrials/Materials on export strength, Banks neutral on stable rates, Tech at risk if NASDAQ momentum fades. Watch US Jobless Claims at 14:30 CET for intraday catalyst. Core thesis: tactically bullish but overbought—prefer selective longs (exporters, Boliden) over broad index long.
